args.sql:
CREATE VIEW vw_panel_efficiency AS
SELECT
    p.panemark AS panel_identifier,
    perf.efficiency_profile -> 'current_efficiency' ->> 'curreffpct' AS current_efficiency_percent,
    perf.efficiency_profile -> 'current_efficiency' ->> 'efflosspct' AS efficiency_loss_percent,
    perf.efficiency_profile -> 'degradation' ->> 'anndegrate' AS annual_degradation_rate_percent,
    perf.efficiency_profile -> 'degradation' ->> 'cumdegpct' AS cumulative_degradation_percent
FROM
    panel p
JOIN
    performance perf ON p.panemark = perf.solmodref;

CREATE VIEW vw_panel_efficiency AS
SELECT
    p.panemark AS panel_identifier,
    perf.efficiency_profile -> 'current_efficiency' ->> 'curreffpct' AS current_efficiency_percent,
    perf.efficiency_profile -> 'current_efficiency' ->> 'efflosspct' AS efficiency_loss_percent,
    perf.efficiency_profile -> 'degradation' ->> 'anndegrate' AS annual_degradation_rate_percent,
    perf.efficiency_profile -> 'degradation' ->> 'cumdegpct' AS cumulative_degradation_percent
FROM
    panel p
JOIN
    performance perf ON p.panemark = perf.solmodref;
